meta.method: Class 4 (cars and light vans) normal MOT tests carried out in 2024 with result pass, fail or PRS (passed after a repair within an hour), one row per test. First-time pass rate = passes / all those tests (DVSA's initial failure rate, turned around). Grouped by make + model (trim and engine names merged) + year of first registration, 2004-2021. A year needs 1,000+ tests. Same-age average = every car (or every van) first registered that year. Failure areas and items = share of tests with at least one fail or PRS defect there.
